title: docs(pm-dispatch): rule how clause ② is graded — provisional claim, mechanical floor, judged conformance
body:
Fixes #14047

Lands the ruling's answer to the clause-② grading question in the ONE file the ruling names
as its 落点, and pays the line ratchet it crosses.

## The ruling, verbatim and untranslated

Maintainer, 2026-09-01, comment 5494466874 (项目总监席 batch, maintainer's reply 逐字:「同意」):

> ## 裁决:(3) + (1) 的窄半 —— claim 声明按设计临时,真闸门在档位复审;新导出符号/新载荷键恒为 yes(维护者 2026-09-01,总监批 #23)
>
> 1. **(3) 获批**:claim 时的 `Clause-②: yes|no` 声明**按设计即临时(provisional)** —— 它定派发档位的保守方向,⛔ 不是终审;真闸门在 PR/报告时的档位复审,证据与成本都在那里。声明被档位推翻**不是席位过失**,是机制按设计工作(本卡四标本中两例即如此);
> 2. **(1) 的窄半获批,作为机械地板**:**任何新导出符号或已发布载荷上的新键,恒为 yes** —— claim 时可查树、无需判断,直接锁 fable 档;
> 3. **conformance 类(B/D 型)⛔ 不机械化**:「向已声明面看齐 vs 收窄/加宽」的判别需要档位判断 —— 当天 #14089 即活标本(车道把 narrowing 读成 conformance 恢复,档位纠正)。裁定:claim 拿不准 ⇒ **按 yes 派 fable 档**(地板的保守方向,假 yes 自纠、假 no 出货);
> 4. **(1) 全量分类学与 (2) 决策程序不建**(创业镜头:现行机制四例四对,代价是复审轮不是出货缺陷);
> 5. **落点**:`references/contract-review.md`(受治面,skills 车道;若触行数天花板,按 #13900 裁决同型引用本评论提额)。⛔ 不重开四个标本 PR。

## What landed — per item, 落点 | before | after

All three land as bullets in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`,
in section 「载体纪律(挂与清)」, immediately after the 适用性 bullet — the file's existing
home for "what falls under clause ② and how it is graded". No new section: the ruling adds
grading rules to an applicability section that already exists.

| # | ruling item | 落点 | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | claim declaration is provisional by design | 载体纪律, new bullet 「claim 声明按设计临时(provisional)」 | the file said nothing about the claim-time declaration at all — its first mention of `Clause-②` was as a place forward-looking facts live | 「`Clause-②: yes\|no` 只定派发档位的保守方向,⛔ 非终审;真闸门在 PR/报告时的档位复核 —— 证据与成本在那里。声明被档位推翻 = 机制按设计工作,⛔ 不作席位过失。」 |
| 2 | mechanical floor: new exported symbol / new published-payload key | 载体纪律, new bullet 「机械地板」, first limb | absent — the tier floor lived only in `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` output, never in the review reference | 「任何**新导出符号**或**已发布载荷上的新键**恒 `yes`,直接锁契约复审档」, marked claim 时可查树、无需判断 |
| 3 | conformance class NOT mechanized; can't-tell dispatches as `yes` | same bullet, second limb | absent | 「**conformance 类 ⛔ 不机械化**(填充已声明字段、在两个已发布码之间重选输入类):判别需档位判断,claim 拿不准 ⇒ **按 yes 派契约复审档**(假 yes 自纠、假 no 出货)」 |
| 4 | ⛔ no full taxonomy, no decision procedure | same bullet, closing clause | absent | 「⛔ 不建全量分类学与 claim 时决策程序(创业镜头:代价是复审轮)」 |

Ruling item 5 is the 落点 itself. Not done, deliberately: the four specimen PRs were not
reopened, and no file other than the reference (plus the ratchet's own CEILINGS row) is touched.

Provenance follows the file's own convention — 「维护者 2026-09-01「同意」」, by date and
quoted words. The file's header forbids issue ids (「⛔ 不引 issue 编号」) and
`check:pm-skill-id-lint` scans it against `/#[0-9]{3,}/`, so no card number appears in the
reference. The ruling's own authorizing sentence, which does carry an id, is quoted in the
CEILINGS map comment in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` — outside that gate's
`SCAN_ROOT`, which is `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch` only.

## Line arithmetic

| | lines | ceiling | headroom |
|---|---|---|---|
| before | 60 | 60 | 0 |
| after payment (−2) | 58 | 60 | 2 |
| after the ruled addition (+7) | 65 | 65 | 0 |

Payment came FIRST and it is real deleted bytes — **not a re-wrap**. 313 bytes went, and the
放行 bullet fell from 6 lines to 4.

### Per-line 落点 of each deletion

1. **`FAIL ⇒ 补丁轮;卡在决策 ⇒ 只进决策箱,⛔ 永不自裁 —— 真正设计分叉照旧升级维护者;`** (118 B)
   — restates SKILL.md 「条款②入队闸门」 almost phrase for phrase: 「FAIL ⇒ 补丁轮;⛔ 免复核不放行;
   真正设计分叉照旧进决策箱,席内复核 ⛔ 不替代维护者裁定」. **Surviving anchor**: SKILL.md, which
   this file's own header line 3 already points at — 「出处:主文件条款②闸门(原则/双肢与档位单源在彼)」.
   No rule is lost; the rule keeps its single source.
2. **`**三样不变**:受管面照旧 draft-only + 终局两条(人工直合或授权批准钉 head 入队,单源见主文件)、⛔ 席位永不代批;FAIL / REWORK 原样;降档保险丝原样。`** (195 B)
   — a self-declared restatement: it says 「单源见主文件」 in its own text. **Surviving anchors**, two:
   SKILL.md's ACCEPT 终局四件套 for the governed-surface limb, and — inside this same file —
   落地前检三条's 「受管面不适用,draft-only 终局不变」. Its remaining half (「FAIL / REWORK 原样;
   降档保险丝原样」) is a "nothing changed" statement carrying no rule, written when the in-seat
   rework landed; 降档保险丝 is the section directly below it.

### Restatements measured and REJECTED as payment

A LINE ratchet cannot bank a deletion that does not cross a 120-byte boundary. These three are
real restatements, and deleting them buys nothing, so they were left alone rather than touched
for a number that would not move:

- 停靠短暂(只防复核完成前误入队) in the 双载体 bullet — restates SKILL.md 「复核完成前短暂停靠」. −45 B, 3 lines → 3.
- 非放行必要条件 in the 外部评审链 bullet — restates SKILL.md 「非放行前提」. −24 B, 4 lines → 4.
- 可复审增量存在前永不挂标,提前挂已废止 in the 不预挂 bullet — restates SKILL.md 「随可复审契约增量同笔挂 … 前瞻预挂已废止(维护者 2026-08-28 裁定)」, same provenance date. −63 B, 2 lines → 2.

### Why the residual +5 could not be paid

The ruled addition is 773 bytes of content. At the gate's own 120-byte cap that is **7 lines
minimum** (6 × 120 = 720 bytes, less than 773), so no six-line spelling exists that keeps the
ruled substance — and the last thing that would have to go is 「不是出货缺陷」, which is the
ruling's own stated justification for declining the taxonomy. Every landed line was checked
against the cap; the only over-120-byte lines in the file are the two legacy quotation-exempt
ruling quotes that were already there (122 B and 125 B), left exactly as their author broke them.

The raise is authorized by the ruling itself, verbatim and untranslated, from comment 5494466874:

> 若触行数天花板,按 #13900 裁决同型引用本评论提额

That sentence and its comment id are also quoted beside the row in the CEILINGS map, per the
map's standing convention. Ceiling set to the exact landed count, headroom 0.

## Gates

Every one run through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, exit code captured by redirect BEFORE any
pipe, on committed head **f9991750** (working tree clean at the time of the run).

| gate | exit | its own verdict line |
|---|---|---|
| `check:pm-skill-ratchet` | 0 | `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md is 65 lines (ceiling 65; headroom 0).` |
| `check:pm-skill-ratchet --self-test` | 0 | `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet self-test: 111 cases pass.` |
| `check:pm-skill-id-lint` | 0 | `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 23 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g).` |
| `check:skill-frame-sync` | 0 | `✓ check-skill-frame-sync: 4 copies of the decision frame are structurally isomorphic across 3 files` |
| `check:skill-frame-freshness` | 0 | `✓ check-skill-frame-freshness: the decision frame in this tree is current with origin/main (fetched just now).` |
| `check:pm-dispatch-gates` | 0 | `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1240 cases pass.` |
| `check:pm-governed-merges` | 0 | `✓ check-governed-merges --self-test: 241 assertions (…)` |
| `check:nul-bytes` | 0 | `check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 8004 text file(s) -- 8004 tracked, 0 untracked-not-ignored; skipped 7 binary; no raw ASCII control bytes).` |

### Full union, re-derived AFTER the last edit

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`, no hand-fed
paths, re-run on head f9991750 and byte-identical to the pre-commit derivation. It resolved the
change set from git itself — 2 paths, committed 2 / working tree 0 — and named 20 commands.

**15 of 20 measured, all exit 0**: the 8 above plus `check:agent-test-spelling`,
`check:bash32-floor`, `check:cli-command-ids`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`,
`check:entry-guard`, `check:parse-guard`, `check:pnpm-filter-targets`,
`check:watch-hint-literal`, `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`,
`scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs --self-test`.

**5 of 20 NOT MEASURED — never green, never a flake.** Each exited 3 with its own PREREQUISITE
text (「Nothing was measured: this gate exited before running a single check」): the fresh
worktree has no `node_modules`, which these five need. They are
`scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`, `scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`,
`scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`,
and `pnpm check:doc-authoring`. This is a **declared narrowing**:
the diff touches one `.claude/**` markdown file and one `scripts/pm/` gate script, so none of the
five has an input in this change set, and CI runs the farm exactly once regardless.

Beyond the derived families: the diff edits a gate script, so that script's own suite was run
separately — `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test` (111 cases, above). The repo carries no
`*.test.ts` naming it; the two other scripts that mention it
(`check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `check-published-list-mirrors.mjs`) reference it only in prose
and were run anyway, both exit 0.

No changeset: this releases nothing. `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` enumerates the class in
its own words — 「It releases nothing (.github/, .claude/, skills/, docs/, content/, examples/,
tests-only, and the like)」 — and its guidance for that class is exactly this PR's shape: apply
the `skip-changeset` label instead. Governed surface (`.claude/**`), so this PR stays **draft**.

## Follow-up, recorded not fixed

SKILL.md is deliberately untouched. One line in it reads in tension with 「provisional」 and is
worth the maintainer's eye — in 「条款②入队闸门」: 「错误的 `no` 是记录在案、可审计的假申报」.
Calling a wrong `no` a 假申报 frames the seat, while the ruling says a declaration overturned at
tier 「不是席位过失,是机制按设计工作」. The two are reconcilable — the ruling's 「不是席位过失」
is about being overturned at tier, and 假申报 is about the one direction that ships — but the
wording is the kind that gets read alone. Not edited here: the ruling names one 落点, and this
is not it.

  first said the card carried no claim comment with this session's URL. It does: comment

  `claude/issue-14047-clause2-classes`, declaring `Clause-②: no`. The false reading was a READ
  artifact, not a fact about the card — the issue page's SSR payload preloads only the first 15
  timeline items and the claim comment sits past that page, so "absent from the payload" was
  taken for "absent". A direct comment read settles it. The brief's premise held; the assignee
  (`os-litant`) and `pm:dispatched` / `domain:skills` / `priority:p2` were correct as stated.

  apply: this diff touches `.claude/skills/**`, and the ratchet's own header states the published
  `skills/` catalog is deliberately OUTSIDE the ceiling — a different surface.
- Channel: this session's GitHub gate is CLOSED. Every repo-scoped REST path answers 403
  (`GitHub access is not enabled for this session`), authenticated and not, and `gh` is absent.
